default.style: Write naturally as this user would.

naive_terse.style: Write a short, terse search message, about 12 words, and skip pleasantries.

naive_keyword.style: Reply like a real user typing fast: very brief, blunt, almost keyword-style.

oracle_stats.style: Average about 13 words per message. About 2% of the time include polite phrasing. About 8% of the time use a very short phrase of 3 words or fewer.

loop_final.style: Average 14 words per message. Occasionally include polite phrasing (approx. 10% of the time) and occasionally use very short, terse phrases of 3 words or fewer (approx. 8% of the time).
